recommendation: Keep this no-change audit as-is. If FHIR-I wants to revise the version-specific profile URL table or add release-specific rows, that should be handled under a new or existing versioning-page tracker rather than reopening FHIR-16165.
issue_request: FHIR-16165 asked to add a fhirVersion data element to Resource so resources exchanged as attachments or data objects outside REST could identify their FHIR version. The accepted resolution did not add a Resource child; it directed the specification to document the MIME-type parameter, version-specific profile usage, and resolvability of those version-specific profile URLs.
initial_application: The Jira application note cites svn revision 13842. Git commit 6c524e959315a07f484862bbcd627c2ce90a3057, GF#16165 - clarify how versioning works, added source/versioning.html, updated source/resource/resource-notes.xml to link Meta.profile to version-specific profile guidance, and updated source/versions.html. Current source/http.html also retains the MIME-type fhirVersion parameter guidance.
additional_context: Zulip discussion and FHIR-I Cologne WGM minutes show the work group compared MIME metadata, resource-specific attributes, a Meta.fhirVersion-style element, and Resource.meta.profile, then chose metadata/context mechanisms rather than adding a new Resource element. Later related issues FHIR-35779, FHIR-35780, and FHIR-41622 audited the version-specific profile table and package-resolvability wording and are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope source/versioning.html, source/http.html, source/versions.html, and source/resource/resource-notes.xml already document the approved mechanisms, and source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml defines the existing Resource children without Resource.fhirVersion.
